Fenix First-Print local · browser-only

Docket flows into the Word header and the Visio drawing header. Field phrase fills “The following relates generally to ….”

Format: each claim starts with its number (e.g. 1. or 15.) on its own line; limitation lines follow. Independent claims are auto-detected as method vs system (also apparatus / CRM). Text is never rewritten.

Figures — order sets FIG numbers and reference numbers

Diagram: components become boxes numbered N00, N05, N10… (N = figure number). A component that recurs across figures is the same element — it auto-links in the Detailed Description. Flowchart: steps become boxes numbered N05, N10… with arrows and side reference numbers; give a step a refers-to element to generate its “operations of this step refer to…” sentence.

Elements — derived from component names (case-insensitive). One element per unique name, shared across figures.

This is the matter’s element list. Rename a component anywhere and it updates here. Same name in two figures = one element (different reference numbers per figure). Autocomplete on components and step “refers-to” fields pulls from this list.

Figure libraries — boilerplate figures with prose, math, and drawings

Drop one or more library .json files here. Packs persist in this browser. Inserted figures renumber themselves — a figure placed at FIG. 9 gets 900, 905… in both the specification and the drawings. Reference numbers are never typed by hand.

Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. Autosaves to this browser’s local storage.
Shortcuts: Shift+N new figure (or new claim line on Claims) · Shift+C new component/step in the current figure · Enter in a component/step adds the next · Alt+↑/↓ reorder the item you’re editing · Shift+F/K/M/E jump to a tab · Esc unfocus.
